title: nice-git.nvim
tagline: A VSCode-style, mouse-friendly Git interface for Neovim
description: nice-git.nvim brings a Source Control panel to Neovim that works entirely with the mouse or the keyboard. It shows full-file diffs you can edit in place, a colored commit graph, one-click conflict resolution and an interactive rebase you plan by dragging commits. It is written in pure Lua with no dependencies and takes its colors from your colorscheme.
role: Sole developer: design, implementation and testing
highlights: Clickable Source Control panel: stage by drag and drop, commit, sync and switch branches
Full-file diffs, side by side or inline, with syntax colors and staging per change
Commit graph drawn from commit parents, with colored lanes and branch and tag labels
One-click conflict resolution and an interactive rebase planned by dragging commits
Pure Lua with no dependencies; every git call runs asynchronously
Colors derived from any colorscheme, readable in light and dark themes
